_comment: Payload fields Mordred plugins consume per Hermes hook. Keys must match exactly the hooks registered by mordred_hermes plugins (tests/test_hook_payload_drift.py enforces this); values are the sorted kwargs the handlers read. Consumers: network/hooks.py + activity/boundary.py on_session_start (session_id), activity/boundary.py on_session_end and on_session_finalize (session_id; completed and interrupted are optional keyword arguments; the newer failed and exit-reason fields are never required), privacy_check + network pre_tool_call (tool_name), llm_guard + network pre_api_request (base_url, provider), and extension/gateway_plugin.py pre_gateway_dispatch (event, gateway). pre_llm_call (dbcrypt's per-turn database check) only needs the hook to fire; network cleanup and keyvault resealing on on_session_end read no field.
